### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials

P0 (root) — good-standing phone payment; P1 — the late fee for the missed 2026-10-07 due date. P0 waits on P1; order P1 then P0.

Hop P0 → P1 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (good_standing_phone_payment): "The good-standing amount is fixed only after the late fee owed for the missed due date stands on the account."
- Records: statement 2026-09 min 143.27, due 2026-10-07, no payment credited from 2026-09-12 through 2026-10-07; ledger shows no fee_type 'late_fee' line at all → the state does not hold.
- The write, found by the sentence's words ("late fee owed", "missed"): late_fee_posting — "When the payments credited from a statement's date through its due date total less than that statement's minimum payment due, one late fee is owed for that statement period; it posts on the day after the due date, references the statement and carries that statement's period." (also late_fee_occurrence clause 1). Its tool is named only in its own invocation block. Amount from late_fee_amount + factor docs.
- P1 has no prerequisite sentence → tree ends.

Counter-proofs.
- "Do only what was asked" (pay now without the fee): the blocked doc says the amount "is not fixed" while the late fee does not stand; paying 122.75 (no late fee) would leave the 12.00 fee unpaid after it posts, so the account is not returned to good standing. Excluded by visible sentence + records.
- Open dispute: "While it is open the disputed amount is left out of the minimum payment … cannot make the account delinquent, and the undisputed balance must still be paid" — the undisputed minimum (112.27) also went unpaid, so the late fee is still owed; the owed-minimum doc recomputes the minimum. The alternative "no late fee because of the dispute" is excluded.
- Alternative fee level 32.00 or 43.00 (repeat): excluded by the 2025-06-18 return being outside 6 months and no late fee in 24 months.
- Alternative bridge start (due date): excluded by the 31-day gap row.
- Alternative excess basis 'promo_expiry_window': end dates 2027-05/2027-08 are far outside 2 billing cycles.
- Courtesy waiver of the new fee: only "at the cardholder's request"; the customer asks for nothing else.

Observations recorded for the dependency-form scan (not judged here): the late-fee factor documents name each other's steps — late_fee_autopay_pattern "the sum of the fee level and the balance add-on"; late_fee_installation_payment_relief "once the sum of the fee level and the balance add-on has received its payment-pattern treatment, and before the late fee is limited to the latest statement's minimum payment due"; late_fee_statement_balance_addon "added to the fee level". To be checked against the source's method text.
